Class SplitNode

java.lang.Object
tree.Node
tree.SplitNode
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<SplitNode>
Direct Known Subclasses:
ContinuousNode, DiscreteNode
abstract class SplitNode extends Node implements Comparable<SplitNode>
Modella l'astrazione dell'entità nodo di split (continuo o discreto) estendendo la superclasse Node.
